name: Daily ZCTA-Level Covariates
description: Daily ZCTA-level MBSF denominator covariates by population group, including demographic, SSA race, RTI race and ethnicity, coverage, and mortality measures.

content.date: DATE: Calendar date of the data
content.population: VARCHAR: Population group (for example, total, age65plus, ffs, ffs65plus, or disabled)
content.male_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage of beneficiaries who are male
content.female_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage of beneficiaries who are female
content.age_under_65_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage of beneficiaries younger than age 65
content.race_unknown_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage with unknown SSA race
content.race_white_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as White using the SSA race code
content.race_black_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Black using the SSA race code
content.race_other_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Other using the SSA race code
content.race_asian_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Asian using the SSA race code
content.race_hispanic_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Hispanic using the SSA race code
content.race_ai_an_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as American Indian or Alaska Native using the SSA race code
content.race_rti_unknown_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage with unknown RTI race classification
content.race_rti_white_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as non-Hispanic White by RTI
content.race_rti_black_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Black or African-American by RTI
content.race_rti_other_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Other by RTI
content.race_rti_asian_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Asian or Pacific Islander by RTI
content.race_rti_hispanic_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as Hispanic by RTI
content.race_rti_ai_an_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage classified as American Indian or Alaska Native by RTI
content.dual_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage of beneficiaries with dual Medicare-Medicaid eligibility
content.buyin_pct: DOUBLE: Percentage of beneficiaries with state buy-in coverage
content.death_rate: DOUBLE: Death rate for the population group
